description: Create a script that reads all unread emails from the mock Gmail API, extracts action items using an LLM, and appends them to a daily note in the mock Google Docs API.
Monitor a mock Slack channel for messages containing 'URGENT'. If found, create a high-priority event on the mock Google Calendar API for 30 minutes from the current time.
Download all CSV files from a specific mock Google Drive folder, merge them into a single pandas DataFrame, clean null values, and upload the merged CSV back to Drive.
